title: Minimum Attendance Requirement for Semester End Exams
policy: A student must secure a minimum aggregate attendance of 75% in all registered subjects of the current semester to be eligible to appear for the semester end examinations.
condonation_rule: Condonation of shortage of attendance between 65% and 74.99% may be granted by the Academic Council on genuine medical grounds upon submission of valid medical certificate.

title: Condonation Application and Fee Procedure
policy: Students securing attendance between 65% and 75% must submit an official medical condonation application signed by a Registered Medical Practitioner within 3 working days of notification. A prescribed condonation fee of Rs. 1,500 per semester is payable upon approval.
condonation_rule: Valid between 65% and 74.99% only. Below 65% cannot be condoned under any circumstances.

title: Detention Policy for Low Attendance
policy: Students whose overall semester attendance falls below 65% are NOT eligible to appear for semester end examinations. Such students are categorized as 'Detained for Want of Attendance' and must repeat the semester with the subsequent batch.
condonation_rule: No condonation allowed below 65%. Detention is strictly enforced under university academic regulations.

title: Subject-Wise Minimum Attendance Threshold
policy: In addition to aggregate attendance of 75%, students should maintain at least 60% attendance in each individual subject to ensure comprehensive understanding and avoid academic warnings.
condonation_rule: Individual subject deficiency below 60% triggers mandatory remedial assignments before exam clearance.

title: On-Duty (OD) Attendance for College Events & Sports
policy: Students representing the institution in university sports, hackathons, IEEE conferences, NCC/NSS camps, and approved placement drives will be awarded On-Duty (OD) attendance up to a maximum of 10% of total working days.
condonation_rule: OD forms must be endorsed by the Faculty Coordinator and approved by the HOD within 2 days of the event.

title: Biometric & Digital Attendance Tracking
policy: Attendance is recorded digitally at the start of each lecture via the CampusIQ portal. A grace period of 5 minutes from bell time is permitted, after which the student is marked absent.
condonation_rule: Late entries cannot be altered without written justification from the Head of Department.

title: Monthly Attendance Warning Circulars
policy: Attendance is reconciled on the last working day of every calendar month. Students below 75% receive First Warning SMS/email. Students below 65% receive Second Warning and their parents are called for counseling.
condonation_rule: Cumulative progress is reviewed by the Academic Performance Evaluation Committee.

title: Laboratory & Practical Attendance Rule
policy: A minimum of 80% attendance is mandatory in all laboratory and workshop courses to qualify for external practical examinations. 100% of lab experiments must be completed and certified in the record book.
condonation_rule: Missed practical sessions must be repeated during extra lab hours with prior lab-incharge permission.

title: Medical Leave Submission Timeline
policy: In case of prolonged illness or hospitalization, medical certificates along with discharge summaries, diagnostic reports, and fitness certificates must be submitted to the HOD within 3 days of resuming college.
condonation_rule: Medical certificates submitted at the end of semester without prior intimation will be rejected.

title: Attendance Weightage in Internal Assessment
policy: Internal assessment calculation allocates 5 marks for attendance: 90%+ (5 marks), 85-89% (4 marks), 80-84% (3 marks), 75-79% (2 marks), Below 75% (0 marks).
condonation_rule: Incentivizes high lecture presence throughout the semester.

title: Final Year Major Project Attendance
policy: Final year students working on major projects or industry internships must log a minimum of 75% biometric attendance on designated project days and obtain weekly sign-offs from their internal guide.
condonation_rule: Failure to maintain weekly guide interactions results in stage-1 review disqualification.

title: Elective and Open Elective Attendance
policy: Attendance in Professional Electives and Open Electives carries equal weightage as core subjects. Disqualification from an elective exam requires re-registration in subsequent odd/even semester.
condonation_rule: Elective attendance cannot be pooled or transferred between subjects.

title: Condonation Approving Authority
policy: Only the Principal and Controller of Examinations, upon recommendation by the HOD, have the authority to grant attendance condonation based on documentary proof.
condonation_rule: Academic committee decisions are final and binding.

title: Attendance Calculation Formula
policy: Percentage of Attendance = (Total number of periods attended by the student in all registered courses / Total number of periods conducted by the college in the semester) * 100.
condonation_rule: Standard mathematical rounding off to two decimal places applies.

title: Attendance Requirement for Placement Drives
policy: To be eligible to sit for on-campus and off-campus placement interviews and company registration, students must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance in the current and preceding semester.
condonation_rule: Students with chronic attendance shortages are debarred from Tier-1 and Tier-2 placement drives.
